description: SevenByte portfolio — security toolbox developer, Node.js, Termux-friendly, Red + Purple, zero dependency.

scripts.check: node -c server.js && node -c sw.js && node -c app.js && node -e "JSON.parse(require('fs').readFileSync('manifest.json','utf8'));JSON.parse(require('fs').readFileSync('package.json','utf8'));console.log('all files OK')"
scripts.backup: for f in index.html style.css app.js server.js sw.js manifest.json package.json; do [ -f "$f" ] && cp "$f" "$f.bak.$(date +%s)"; done; echo 'backup done'
